payload.rationale: Blocking id_integrity failures cannot be repaired under Patch Generator constraints. Fixing deliverable ID format violations would require changing existing "/id" values under /plan_package/milestones/*/deliverables/*/id, which is disallowed. Fixing architecture option risk-reference violations would require editing /plan_package/architecture/options (locked canonical section) and/or adding new K# entries to /plan_package/risk_register (locked), both disallowed. Additionally, evidence pointer reference validation appears to depend on an external canonical artifact_ref/artifact_id convention that is not defined here; correcting it safely requires schema/validator owner guidance.
